steps:
0. Required Roles and Access Preparation
Procedure
Open Oracle Fusion homepage.
Locate the Navigator icon with three horizontal lines in the upper-left corner.
Open the Navigator menu.
Expand the Tools section.
Click Security Console.
Open the Users tab near the upper section of the page.
Use the search field near the top-center area to locate the target user.
Click the user row from the search results table.
Click Edit near the upper-right section of the user details page.
Scroll to the Roles section.
Click Add Role.
Search for the required role name.
Select the matching role from the role search results.
Repeat for all required roles.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right section of the page.
Log out and log back in to activate role changes.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

10. Update Corp Card Program to Point to Non-PROD SFTP
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Corporate Card Programs.
Open RCSD Corporate Card Program.
Open the Transfer Parameters tab.
Locate the Account Name field.
Add XX to the beginning of the Account Name.
Locate the Profile Name field.
Add XX to the beginning of the Profile Name.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

11. Disable GetThere Configuration
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Travel Partner Integrations.
Open GetThere configuration.
Locate the Username field in the middle section of the configuration page.
Enter a random value.
Locate the Connection Password field below the Username field.
Enter a random value.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right section.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

12. Remove Receivables System Email Options
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Receivables System Options.
Locate Transaction Delivery Using Email section.
Clear the From Email field.
Locate Statement Delivery Using Email section.
Clear the From Email field.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

15. Update or Remove HireRight Configuration
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Recruiting Category Provisioning and Configuration.
Locate HireRight in the integrations table.
Click the Edit icon beside the HireRight row.
Locate the Reference Key field.
Set the value to TORS09-PROD.
Locate the Client ID field.
Set the value to TORS09.
Locate the Client Secret field.
Set the value to RCSD053124!.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

16. Pre-Note: Update JPMC SFTP to Non-PROD or Disable Delivery
Procedure
Navigate to My Client Groups.
Open Data Exchange.
Open Extract Definitions.
Enable Show Filters.
Search the required extract definitions under US Legislative Data Group.
Open the extract definition.
In the left-side navigation panel, click Deliver.
Locate the prenote delivery option.
Delete the highlighted prenote delivery entry.
Click Validate.
Click Done.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

17. ADMIN User Accounts Creation
Procedure
Open Navigator.
Expand Tools.
Click Security Console.
Open Users tab.
Click Add User Account near the upper-right section.
Enter Username opkey.bi.admin.
Set Password to Welcome1.
Click Add Role.
Assign required roles.
Click Save and Close.
Repeat the process for opkey.sec.admin.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

18. User Accounts for API
Procedure
Open Security Console.
Open Users tab.
Click Add User Account.
Create the environment-specific API integration user.
Set Password to Welcome1.
Assign the required integration-related roles.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

doc_section: Check if Notifications are set to
steps:
1. Check if Notifications are set to None
Procedure
Locate the Notifications icon in the upper-right corner of the Oracle Fusion page.
Click the Notifications icon.
Click Show All in the notification popup window.
The Worklist page opens.
Click the logged-in username near the upper-right area of the Worklist page.
Select Administration from the dropdown menu.
Scroll downward until the Notifications section becomes visible.
Locate the Notification Mode dropdown.
Set Notification Mode to None.
Click Save near the lower-right section of the page.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

21. Disable Separate Remittance Advice Outgoing Emails
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Disbursement System Options.
Locate Separate Remittance Advice from Email field.
Remove the existing email value.
Click Save and Close.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

22. Journeys Tasks with External URL
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Checklist Templates.
Search for Leave of Absence.
Open the checklist template.
Click Tasks.
For every task with Task Type equal to External URL, open the task.
Locate the URL field in the middle section of the task configuration page.
Update the environment-specific portion of the URL.
Keep the base URL unchanged.
Click Save and Close.
Repeat for all external URL tasks.
Repeat for Medical Leave Journey and Leave Extension templates.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

23. Work Force Structure: Positions
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Extensible Flexfields.
Search for PER_POSITIONS_LEG_EFF.
Select the result row.
Open Actions menu near the upper section of the table.
Click Refresh and Deploy Offline.
Wait for deployment to complete.
Search for PER_POSITIONS_EIT_EFF.
Select the result row.
Open Actions menu.
Click Refresh and Deploy Offline.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

doc_section: Change Color Scheme and Banner Message
steps:
2. Change Color Scheme and Banner Message Update
Procedure
Click the logged-in username in the upper-right corner of Oracle Fusion.
Select Setup and Maintenance.
Open the Tasks panel near the left section of the page.
Use the search field to search for Manage Administrator Profile Values.
Open the matching task.
Search for profile option FND_BANNER_MESSAGE.
Locate the Profile Values section in the middle of the page.
Click the New icon above the values table.
Set Profile Level to Site.
Enter the environment banner message in the Profile Value text field.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right area.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

3. Disable or Update ADP Integrations to Point to Test Environment
Procedure
Open Navigator from the upper-left corner.
Expand My Client Groups.
Click Data Exchange.
In the HCM Extracts section located in the center of the page, click Extract Definitions.
Click Show Filters near the upper-right section.
Set Legislative Data Group to US Legislative Data Group.
Search for Payslip.
Click the Payslip extract row from the results table.
In the left-side navigation panel, click Deliver.
Locate ADP_SC_GarnOnly_Payslip in the delivery options table.
Open the delivery option.
Set End Date to 01/01/2001.
Click OK in the lower-right corner of the popup.
Scroll to the Report Categories section.
Expand Additional Details.
Select ADP_SC_GarnOnly_Payslip.
Click Delete located above or beside the Additional Details table.
Click Validate in the upper-right toolbar.
Click Done near the upper-right area.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

4. Add IP Addresses
Procedure
Open Navigator.
Expand Tools.
Click Security Console.
Open the Administration tab near the upper section of the page.
Open Location Based Access.
Locate the IP Address entry field in the middle section of the page.
Add the required IP addresses separated by commas.
Click outside the field so the Save button becomes enabled.
Click Save near the upper-right section.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

7. Turn off PO Communication
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Administrator Profile Values.
Search for PO_NOTIFICATION_OVERRIDE_E-MAIL.
Set the profile value to a dummy email address.
Click Save.
Search for PO_CONTROL_SUPPLIER_COMMUNICATION.
Set the profile value to Disable.
Click Save.
Search for PO_FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS.
Set the profile value to Buyer.
Click Save.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.

9. Disabling AP Payment Transmission to the Bank
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Payment Process Profiles.
Open each highlighted payment process profile one at a time.
Open the Payment System tab.
Locate the Automatically Transmit Payment File After Formatting checkbox in the middle section.
Uncheck the checkbox.
Open the Reporting tab.
Locate Separate Remittance Advice settings.
Ensure Delivery Method is blank.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right section.
Repeat for all highlighted payment process profiles.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
